proposed_quote: HpmB is necessary for the extracellular secretion and activation of HpmA
notes: Cited ref 10.1128/jb.172.3.1206-1216.1990 = Uphoff & Welch 1990 (PMID 2407716, PMC208585), P. mirabilis clinical isolate 477-12 vs row HI4320 (strain_diff, conserved Hpm). Its abstract DOES document secretion. But the citation_quote (FhaC unable to mediate secretion of HpmA) is NOT from it; it is from Jacob-Dubuisson 1997 (PMID 9006033, DOI 10.1128/jb.179.3.775-783.1997). Ref kept; proposed verbatim secretion quote from the actual cited 1990 paper.

proposed_quote: HxuA is secreted by its specific transporter HxuB. HxuA/HxuB belongs to the so-called two-partner secretion systems (TPSs) that are characterized by a conserved N-terminal domain in the secreted protein which is essential for secretion.
notes: 10.1107/S174430911302962X = Baelen et al 2013 (PMID 24316822, PMC3855712), Acta Cryst F. Quote verbatim from abstract. H. influenzae matches (Rd KW20). TPS/transporter-dependent secretion documented.

10.1128/IAI.72.4.1874-1884.2004 = Ward, Mock & Hansen 2004 (PMID 15039306, PMC375143). Quote verbatim from abstract: LspA1/LspA2 detected in concentrated culture supernatant fluid; LspB-dependent secretion across OM shown. H. ducreyi 35000HP matches.
Same ref as T5SS_13 (10.1128/IAI.72.4.1874-1884.2004, PMID 15039306, PMC375143). Quote verbatim from abstract; culture-supernatant detection + LspB-dependent secretion. H. ducreyi 35000HP matches.

10.1016/j.ijmm.2013.11.021 = Pramanik et al 2014 (PMID 24462008), Int J Med Microbiol. Quote verbatim from abstract: ShlA secreted across OM by ShlB, TPS type Vb. Species S. marcescens matches row Db11. Secretion documented (ShlB-dependent export + in-vitro secretion assays).

10.1084/jem.20020407 = Comanducci et al 2002 (PMID 12045242, PMC2193550). Quote verbatim from abstract but describes structure/oligomerization/epithelial-cell binding = adhesin/vaccine-candidate, NOT secretion. Full text shows surface-exposure + OM-anchoring only; no secretion/translocation assay. N. meningitidis B MC58 matches. Trimeric autotransporter adhesin (T5cSS) but this ref does not document the export step -> weak.

10.1093/emboj/19.22.5989 = Hoiczyk et al 2000 (PMID 11080146, PMC305836), EMBO J. Quote (head/coiled-coil rod/C-terminal membrane anchor) is verbatim from abstract but it is a structure/sequence analysis of YadA as an adhesin; abstract does NOT show secretion/autotransport/translocation. YadA of enteropathogenic Yersinia (genus matches Y. enterocolitica 8081; strain_diff). Documents domain architecture, not secretion -> weak.

10.1111/j.1462-2920.2010.02174.x = Salacha et al 2010 (PMID 20192961), Environ Microbiol. Both quote fragments (joined by ellipsis) verbatim from abstract; abstract also states the patatin moiety is secreted while C-terminus stays in OM (experimental secretion evidence). P. aeruginosa matches PAO1. T5dSS archetype.

proposed_quote: the N-terminal β-barrel domain acts as a translocation pore to secrete the C-terminal passenger domain
notes: 10.1371/journal.pone.0047069 = Oberhettinger et al 2012 (PMID 23056583, PMC3467248). First quote fragment is verbatim and documents secretion. Second fragment (we propose that this class of autotransporters be termed Type Ve secretion) is NOT verbatim; paper says we propose to name the intimin/invasin family of autotransporters type Ve secretion systems. Paper uses EPEC intimin; row is EHEC O157:H7 Sakai (eae conserved LEE autotransporter, strain_diff acceptable). Ref correct; proposed verbatim secretion quote (fragment 1).
